tagline: Methodical to the point of ritualism, Giovanni approaches both his craft and his commercial ventures
bio: Giovanni Contari, once a humble metalworker's son from the crowded parish of San Polo, has forged his destiny through fire and strategic acumen. Rising from the smoky depths of apprenticeship, he has established himself as a respected blacksmith at Salizada dei Consoli while simultaneously cultivating a nascent mercantile enterprise through his Contract Stall at Calle del Paradiso.
